## Book a Private Guided Tour

Did you know that you can book private guided tours at the museum, for both personal occasions and events for companies and societies? A private guided tour can be a wonderful surprise for someone you wish to celebrate, or an inspirational experience for you and your coworkers. Perhaps you will become aware of new contexts and new ways to see art, or notice details that you did not know existed. The guided tours are led by our art educators, who adapt the content to your specific interests. Read more about the different themes below.

### Themes for Private Guided Tours

[Highlights of the collection Let our art educator present highlights of our collection, featuring the foremost artists and artworks. Or, if you prefer, the tour can be adapted to suit your personal highlights! arrow Continued](https://goteborgskonstmuseum.se/en/book-a-tour-highlights-of-the-collection/) [Life and death in art Art depicts all the phases of life – including death. We take a closer look at how artists have depicted life and death in both historical and contemporary art. arrow Continued](https://goteborgskonstmuseum.se/en/book-a-tour-life-and-death-in-art/) [Art and mental illness In what way can art create suffering, or suffering create art? What is the connection between creativity and the unconscious forces of the psyche? arrow Continued](https://goteborgskonstmuseum.se/en/book-a-tour-art-and-mental-illness/) [Nudity in art Have you ever wondered why so many artworks show the nude body? On this tour we get under the skin of the nude artworks at the Gothenburg Museum of Art. arrow Continued](https://goteborgskonstmuseum.se/en/book-a-tour-nudity-in-art/) [What is art? We investigate contemporary art in the collection, emphasizing its diversity of materials and expressions. What is art? What could be art? Who decides, and where are the boundaries, if there are any? arrow Continued](https://goteborgskonstmuseum.se/en/book-a-tour-what-is-art/) [Nordic fin-de-siècle and the Fürstenberg Gallery Hear more about the unique collection of Nordic fin-de-siècle art in the Fürstenberg Gallery. We travel through time from 19th century history painting to the lyrical “Nordic light”. arrow Continued](https://goteborgskonstmuseum.se/en/book-a-tour-nordic-fin-de-siecle-and-the-furstenberg-gallery/) [Explore the Queer in Art Norms are the unwritten rules that we all have to relate to on a daily basis. On this tour, we examine art from the perspective of gender studies and a critique of norms – something that can teach us a lot about both history and the present time. arrow Continued](https://goteborgskonstmuseum.se/en/book-a-tour-norms-in-art/)
